metadata.target_feature: Emergency Lane Keeping (ELK) - High-Speed Road Edge Extended Range

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: Euro NCAP Lane Departure Protocol v1.2 Section 3.1.3 & Appendix A.1

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall provide emergency lane keeping against road edges at high motorway velocities (100 km/h) under lateral departure rates up to 0.7 m/s, redirecting the vehicle back into the lane and maintaining heading stability.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Paved high-speed roadway with grass verge boundary
operational_design_domain.environmental_conditions: Daylight, dry track, wind speed < 10 m/s

decomposition_targets.description: Counteract high lateral kinetic energy before vehicle crosses verge threshold

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph >= 95.0 km/h and LateralVelocity_mps >= 0.5 m/s while DTLE_m <= 0.25 m, ELK_CorrectionTorque_Nm shall assert >= 3.5 Nm within an FTTI of 40 ms, ensuring DTLE_m >= -0.1 m.
